welcome_palace.text: Rea u amohela ntlong ea borena, ke tlotla ho u amohela. Kamore ea hau e se e loketse.

welcome_drink.text: A na nka u fa seno se amohelehang?

early_checkin.text: Kamore ea hau e tla ba teng ka hora e le 'ngoe. Na u ka rata ho lula ka kamoreng ea ho phomola?

card_deposit.text: Re tla nka kgatiso ya karete ya hao ya mokitlane, ntle le hula tjhelete.

valet_keys.text: Na nka nka linotlolo tsa koloi ea hau? Bahlokomeli ba rona ba tla e hlokomela.

car_ready.text: Koloi ea hau e u emetse ka pel 'a monyako.

luggage_storage.text: Re ka boloka mekotla ea hau ho fihlela u tloha.

fragile.text: Na ho na le dintho tse fokolang mekotleng ya hao?

umbrella.text: Pula e ntse e na: Na nka u alima sekotlolo?

suite_tour.text: E re ke u tsebise sebaka sa hau sa marang-rang.

turndown.text: Na u ka rata ho ba le khokahano bosiung bona?

pillow_menu.text: Menyu ea rona ea mosamo ke ena. Ke efe eo u e ratang?

wifi.text: Khoutu ea Wi-Fi e ka fumanoa 'mapeng haufi le mohala.

dietary_req.text: Na u na le mafu a itseng a ho kula kapa lithibelo tsa lijo?

table_tonight.text: O ka rata hore ke u behele tafole bosiung bona?

breakfast_time.text: Lijo tsa hoseng li jeoa ho tloha ka 7:00 hoseng ho fihlela ka 11:00 hoseng.

room_service.text: Tšebeletso ea kamore e fumaneha bosiu le motšehare.

dress_code.text: Seaparo se setle se kopuoa ho tloha reschorenteng bosiung bona.

airport_transfer.text: O ka rata ho fetisetsoa boema-fofane ba poraefete?

theatre_tickets.text: Nka u fa litekete tsa ho ea k 'hamphaning bosiung bona.

private_driver.text: Mokhanni oa poraefete a ka ba teng bakeng sa hau letsatsi lohle.

tour_guide.text: Na u batla motataisi ea buang puo ea hau?

flowers.text: Nka fana ka lipalesa ka kamoreng ea hau ea ho phomola.

spa_booking.text: O ka rata ho etsa kopo ea kalafo ea spa?

health_conditions.text: Na o na le mathata afe kapa afe a bophelo a lokelang ho hlokomelwa ke ngaka?

gym.text: Kamore ea boithabiso e ka fihlelleha ka nako efe kapa efe ka karete ea hau ea kamore.

technician.text: Moenjiniere o fihla ka kamoreng ea hau ka metsotso e 10.

change_room.text: Re ka u fa suite e 'ngoe ntle le litšenyehelo tse ling.

doctor.text: Na o ka rata hore re bitse ngaka?

lost_item.text: Na o ka ntlhalosetsa ntho e lahlehileng?

noise.text: Re kopa ts 'oarelo ka lerata. Re kenella hang-hang.

stay_ok.text: Na ho dula ha hao ho ile ha tsamaya hantle?

invoice_email.text: Na o ka rata ho fumana lengolo-tsoibila la hau ka lengolo-tsoibila?

see_you.text: Kea leboha ka ketelo ea hau, re ts 'epa ho u bona haufinyane.
